name: CupertinoPicker
description: An iOS-style picker that displays its children widgets on a scrollable wheel. It allows users to select a single value from a list of options with a smooth, scrollable interface.

properties.name: itemExtent
properties.description: The height of each child item in the picker.

properties.name: onSelectedItemChanged
properties.description: Called when the user scrolls and selects a new item.

properties.name: children
properties.description: The list of widgets to display as selectable options.

properties.name: diameterRatio
properties.description: Controls the curvature of the wheel. A smaller value makes the wheel more curved.

properties.name: magnification
properties.description: The magnification factor applied to the currently selected item.

properties.name: squeeze
properties.description: The ratio of the item extent to the viewport height, affecting spacing between items.

properties.name: offAxisFraction
properties.description: How far the wheel is horizontally shifted, where 0 is centered.

properties.name: scrollController
properties.description: Controls the scroll position of the picker. Useful for setting the initial selected index.

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.description: The background color of the picker wheel.

properties.name: selectionOverlay
properties.description: A custom widget displayed over the currently selected item. By default, a translucent grey overlay is used.

properties.name: looping
properties.description: Whether the picker loops back to the beginning when reaching the end of the list.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.
